steps.action: On the existing canonical F-host only, run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve or start exactly one persistent daemon.
Verify all four guarded recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat and the exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical output work.

For each target BNG point, query official National_LIDAR_Programme_Catalogues layer 0 in EPSG:27700 and accept only intersecting returned features; record dtm_fn,pnt_fn,tilename,sd_flown,ed_flown,surveys,resolution,year,supplied,latest,polygon_id.

Query official LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents layer 0 in EPSG:27700; record filename,os_ref,sd_flown,ed_flown,pt_spacing,transform,geoid,filepath,year,supplied,latest,polygon_id. Never substitute DSM layer 1.
Obtain the current HMLR INSPIRE polygon in native EPSG:27700 for each target and use it only as an indicative analytical mask, not as a legal title boundary.

Use the persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 route with a real CoverageId obtained from capabilities/describe; retrieve actual raster bytes inside the native polygon and exclude NoData before statistics.

Use the keyless OS Downloads API OpenData route for productId Terrain50 with area=TQ; require a live API response and actual archive bytes containing TQ39,TQ59,TQ27 members plus per-tile metadata, then sample documented 50m pixel centres.

Run three EA-primary/OS-secondary numeric crosschecks, verify port 8012 readback, and resolve the manual action only after recovery receipts, fresh claim and all accepted outputs are remotely verified.
